user.title: Solar Floor Boost
user.description: Pick the thermostats to raise when there is surplus solar energy.

data_description.max_temperature: A boost never sets a target above this value.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Solar Floor Boost is already configured.

data_description.max_temperature: A boost never sets a target above this value.

not_loaded.message: Solar Floor Boost is not set up.

start.name: Start boost
start.description: Raise thermostat targets for a while, then restore the original targets. Calling it during a boost re-applies the amount to the original targets and restarts the timer.

delta.name: Amount
delta.description: Degrees to add to each target. Defaults to the Boost amount entity.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes until targets are restored. Defaults to the Boost duration entity.

climate_entities.name: Thermostats
climate_entities.description: Only boost these. Defaults to all configured thermostats.

stop.name: Stop boost
stop.description: End the boost now and restore the original targets.
